why_null: All four cases in the library were considered and none met the threshold. B-01 turns on a count with nothing behind it driving moral shock into mobilization; this family quotes an official release as issued, and the step under examination is what a recorded total stands for, not where the total came from. B-02 turns on a legal text that was not yet public being filled in with provisions it did not carry; this family has a published statistical release and supplies no text of its own. B-03 turns on a single vivid item compressing the interval between exposure and street mobilization, and this family carries no triggering item, no acceleration and no mobilization at all. B-04 came closest and still fell short: its shape is a rule whose legal text narrowed its reach retold as reaching everything, widening toward alarm and urgency, while the shape here is a monitoring instrument that reaches part of an activity being read as measuring the whole of it, running toward reassurance, with no urgency component and no legal instrument anywhere in the family. Rule reach and instrument coverage are different objects, and the family resemblance of a narrow thing told as a wide one is a similarity of description rather than the repeated causal shape an Echo panel asserts. Silence is what blueprint D-15 permits here.
